name: Japan Recruit AI Agent Skills
description: Simulate Japanese recruitment agency matching logic using publicly available frameworks (SPI3, Portable Skills, Skill Ontology). Start with self-analysis (strengths, work style, career anchors), simulate the scoring logic of Recruit and Persol Career to evaluate candidates and companies from an agency's perspective, then execute the full job-change playbook (resume, interview, negotiation, offer handling, resignation, application tracking).
author: younnieCutler
